message.content:
The **Declaration of Independence** was signed by **56 delegates** from the thirteen colonies who had voted to adopt it on July 4, 1776. The signatures were affixed on August 2, 1776, when the Continental Congress formally adopted the document. Here’s the full list of signers:

| State | Signers |
|-------|---------|
| **Delaware** | Thomas McKean, George Read, Caesar Rodney |
| **Pennsylvania** | John Morton, George Clymer, Benjamin Franklin, Robert Morris, George Taylor, James Smith, George Ross, John Penn, William Allen, John Dickinson, George Whitehill, John Penn, William Allen, John Dickinson, George Whitehill |
| **New Jersey** | William Livingston, John Witherspoon, Abraham Clark, John Hart, William Livingston, John Witherspoon, Abraham Clark, John Hart |
| **Georgia** | Button Gwinnett, Lyman Hall, George Walton |
| **Connecticut** | Roger Sherman, Samuel Huntington, William Williams, Oliver Wolcott, William Samuel Johnson, Jonathan Trumbull |
| **Massachusetts** | John Adams, Samuel Adams, John Hancock, Joseph Warren, Paul Revere, John Hancock, Joseph Warren, Paul Revere |
| **Maryland** | Charles Carroll, Samuel Chase, William Paca, Henry Lee III, Thomas Stone, Charles Carroll, Samuel Chase, William Paca, Henry Lee III, Thomas Stone |
| **South Carolina** | Edward Rutledge, Thomas Heyward Jr., William Hooper, John Rutledge, Edward Rutledge, Thomas Heyward Jr., William Hooper, John Rutledge |
| **New Hampshire** | Josiah Bartlett, William Whipple, Matthew Thornton, Josiah Bartlett, William Whipple, Matthew Thornton |
| **Virginia** | Richard Henry Lee, Francis Lightfoot Lee, Carter Braxton, Thomas Jefferson, James Madison, Patrick Henry, Richard Henry Lee, Francis Lightfoot Lee, Carter Braxton, Thomas Jefferson, James Madison, Patrick Henry |
| **New York** | William Floyd, Philip Livingston, Lewis Morris, William Floyd, Philip Livingston, Lewis Morris |
| **North Carolina** | William Hooper, Joseph Hewes, John Penn, William Hooper, Joseph Hewes, John Penn |
| **Rhode Island** | Stephen Hopkins, William Ellery, Stephen Hopkins, William Ellery |
| **Vermont** | *No representatives* (Vermont was not yet a state) |
